resources.string: Practise counseling with an AI client.
Hold a CBT session with an AI client, then get a supervision report: what went well, what went wrong, what to practise next.

PSYGYM is a practice tool for counselors. An AI plays the client. Every client is fictional. This is not therapy. The conversation is processed by a third-party AI model service; our servers don’t store it.
You are the counselor. Open the session when you’re ready.
This session is long enough. End it to get your supervision report.
We don’t keep this conversation. If you leave, it’s gone.
This feedback is AI-generated, for practice only. The conversation is processed by a third-party AI model service; our servers don’t store it.
You get one from the PSYGYM team. It lets the app reach our server.
Fake cases and replies, no server needed. Debug builds only.
Do you have an invite code?
PSYGYM is invite-only for now. You can also add the code later in Settings.
This session is too long. End it and get feedback, or start a new one.
You need a valid invite code. Add it in Settings.
This case isn’t available any more. Go back and pick another one.
Too many requests right now. Try again in a little while.
The AI is unavailable right now. Try again in a few minutes.
Can’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
This is a practice tool. It can’t help in a crisis. If you or someone near you is in danger, call your local emergency number or a crisis line now.
You are about to talk with a fictional client played by an AI.
The session may touch on depression, anxiety and thoughts of death.
The conversation is processed by a third-party AI model service; our servers don’t store it. Please don’t enter real client information.
Afterwards, an AI supervisor gives you practice feedback. It is not an assessment and not clinical advice.
If you are going through a hard time yourself, please reach out to a professional near you or a helpline below.
